bleu_score.description: Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score measuring n-gram precision against golden reference remediation.

meteor_score.description: METEOR score evaluating unigram precision, recall harmonic mean, and fragmentation penalty.

rouge_score.description: ROUGE-L F1 (longest common subsequence overlap) against the golden reference remediation.

latency_score.description: Tracks turn latency and validates response time against SLA threshold (<= 12.0s).

tokens_consumed_score.description: Tracks prompt, intermediate tool call, and completion token consumption against budget.

llm_judge_score.description: LLM-as-a-Judge rubric score (vulnerability identification, remediation, grounding, completeness), calibrated against human labels.

consistency_score.description: Consistency: standard deviation of trajectory lengths across repeated runs (Reliability Quadrant).

robustness_score.description: Robustness: pass rate when latency, HTTP 5xx faults, or prompt mutations are injected (Reliability Quadrant).

predictability_score.description: Predictability: calibration between the agent's stated confidence and actual success rate (Reliability Quadrant).

safety_score.description: Safety: critical vs. minor failure flags triggered during evaluation, including guardrail coverage (Reliability Quadrant).
